subject: Private VPC Pricing — token volumes & licensing follow-up
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechco.com>; Tom Wells <tom.wells@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-15T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Private VPC Pricing — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the productive discussion. Recap and immediate next steps from my side: 

- Key ask: Private/VPC deployment for production inference across 3 environments (staging, prod, disaster-recovery).
- Expected token volumes: 1B tokens/month initially, scaling to ~5B tokens/month over 12 months (peak bursts up to 8B/month).
- Target unit economics: looking for a target price in the $700–$1,000 per 1M tokens range (inclusive of inference runtime and base licensing).
- Preferred licensing model: up-front enterprise license + per-token usage on top. Customer interested in multi-year term for pricing predictability.
- Support: needs enterprise support (24x7 on-call + 4-hour incident SLA) and an assigned technical account manager.

Next steps: Ben will send a follow-up with two pricing options (one with a higher commit + lower per-token, one with lower commit + higher per-token), plus licensing term options and support tier pricing. Alice/Tom to confirm any internal procurement constraints and whether SSO/KMS integration details are needed at this stage.

Attachments: will follow with a draft pricing workbook and license summary.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Wells <tom.wells@fintechco.com>, procurement@fintechco.com
Date: 2026-10-15T18:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC Pricing — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks Ben — quick clarifications from our side: 

- Volumes: the 1B month number is conservative; core product usage today is ~900M/month and we have a dedicated growth initiative expected to bring that to ~4–5B in 9–12 months. The 8B burst figure is during peak end-of-quarter processing windows.
- Budget: procurement is expecting us to target around $750/1M tokens all-in if possible; anything above $900/1M will require exec approval.
- Environments: yes — staging+prod mandatory. DR can be either a cold DR (in a separate VPC) or a warm standby, but we need the option documented.
- Compliance: we will need SOC 2 evidence and KMS integration details. Also flagging that our security team will run a short questionnaire; I can share it early next week.

If you can send the two pricing options and indicate which support tiers include the 4-hour incident SLA and TAM assignment, that would be great.

Best,
Alice
Director, AI Platforms
FinTechCo

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechco.com>; Tom Wells <tom.wells@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-16T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC Pricing — post-call recap and next steps

Alice — thanks for the clarifications, very helpful. See below two high-level commercial options (I'll attach a simple workbook and the draft license PDF):

Option A — High commit (recommended for predictability)
- Licensing: Up-front enterprise platform license (multi-year, includes private control plane and entitlement to run on-customer VPC) — one-time fee: $225,000/year (spreadable across term).
- Commitment: 3B tokens/month minimum commit averaged across term.
- Usage price (over commit): $600 per 1M tokens.
- Support: Enterprise Plus (24x7 on-call, 4-hour P1 SLA, dedicated TAM) — included in license.
- Environments: Up to 3 environments covered (staging, prod, DR warm). Additional envs: $25k/env/yr.

Option B — Lower commit (more flexible)
- Licensing: Standard enterprise license — $120,000/year.
- Commitment: 1B tokens/month minimum commit.
- Usage price (over commit): $850 per 1M tokens.
- Support: Enterprise (business hours & on-call with 8-hour P1 SLA; TAM available as add-on for $50k/yr).
- Environments: 2 envs included; DR as add-on: $20k/yr.

Notes: 
- Both options assume SOC 2 evidence and KMS integration as standard deliverables; we can share SOC 2 package and a KMS integration checklist in the next email.
- We can do an up-front commit credit structure (prepay to reduce net per-token further) — I can model that in the attached workbook.
- If you need to target $750/1M tokens, Option A with a higher prepaid commit gets you under that level (I'll model a 12-month prepayment scenario).

Attachments: fintechco_pricing_v1.xlsx (pricing workbook), redwood_private_license_terms.pdf (draft license summary).

Let me know if you'd like me to loop in our Security lead (Rachel) to start the SOC 2 questionnaire and KMS details.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Executive
Redwood Inference

- Looks like the $750/1M target is achievable if we push Option A with a 12-month prepay or if procurement is open to a 36-month term.
- Risk: procurement may push back on the $225k license number; be ready to present the included SLAs/TAM and env coverage as justification.
- Next internal steps: Rachel to prep SOC 2 package and KMS checklist; I will model a 12-month prepay scenario and a 36-month term in the workbook (attach updated workbook to next email).
